phases: Phase 1: qor/scripts/plan_absolute_claim_lint.py -- two finding kinds over Locked-Decision sub-blocks, both firing on an absence: a marker sentence with neither paired grep-evidence nor an inline scope qualifier, and the same for a bare cardinal drawn from a closed noun set. Backticked spans are removed content-and-all before matching, which deliberately differs from the parser otherwise reused. Pairing is per-decision, not per-region. Helper names avoid validator prefixes.

Phase 2: make the recurrence machine-visible -- add scope-overgeneralization to the audit findings_categories enum AND to findings_signature._VALID_CATEGORIES, its hardcoded mirror, closing the live drift filed as GH #437; add scope_overgeneralization to the shadow event_type enum; add a rule to remediate_pattern_match.PATTERN_RULES; append FEATURE_INDEX FX029. A parity test binds the two category sources and an escalator test drives stall_walk with the new value.

Phase 3: doctrine and wiring -- a new SG entry citing the lint as its enforcer, one glossary term with a non-empty referenced_by, and one WARN-only ladder line in /qor-audit Step 0.6 within a measured 685-byte margin to the test-enforced HEADROOM_BYTES bound, followed by dist_compile staging all six regenerated artifacts: the four SKILL.md copies the sync tests compare plus the cline workflow and gemini TOML that carry the ladder untested. Eleven unchanged live consumers named.

limitations: The lint reads plan Markdown only; it cannot tell whether an absolute claim is true, only whether the plan pairs it with evidence or a scope qualifier.
Detection is lexical: a claim phrased without any listed quantifier is invisible to it.
WARN-only in V1, matching how skill_size_budget_lint and procedural_fidelity shipped.

Coverage measured, not claimed: against a ten-sentence sample of the real historical instances, marker detection fires on 7. The residual miss is a confidence adjective carrying no countable claim; widening to adjectives would flag ordinary prose, so that case stays uncovered.
non_goals: Judging the truth of any claim.
Any change to /qor-audit's verdict rules or the existing pre-audit lints.
exclusions: The three Phase 258 plan-text corrections named in META_LEDGER entry #730.
Capture-time tree state and declared-versus-actual scope fidelity (GH #434), answered on the boundary and sequenced behind this phase.
GH #436's auditor-amendment clauses; filed, not built here.

A corpus-granularity finding kind, deferred with cause: plan_evidence._EVIDENCE_STMT_RE captures ref, path, line and observed text and not the grep flags, so the narrowed-search case it targets is structurally invisible to a detector reusing that parser; and it misfires on correct citations, which is why three audits could not state a rule separating it from sound reasoning.
